rules.logic: ABIOC(Multi-Stage Intrusion Chain Elevated Above a High-Volume Benign Alert Floor) AND XQL(Alert Grouping Collapse Ratio Across the Labelled Corpus) AND XQL(Triage Classification Confusion Matrix Against the Ground-Truth Label) AND XQL(Benign Near-Miss Alerts Remain Singletons Below the Escalation Floor) observed under one cortexsim_run_tag — the terminal assertion is a measurement, not a merge. The four malicious-labelled stages must resolve to ONE incident ranked above every benign-labelled alert; the hard-positive automation deviation must raise its OWN incident and must NOT be absorbed into the malicious one; the benign near-miss floor must stay singleton and below the escalation floor. Precision and recall are computed from the confusion-matrix query against the author-time label column, and the collapse ratio from the raw-alert to incident count. Failure modes are individually visible and individually reportable: a benign alert inside the malicious incident is a precision failure, a malicious-labelled alert on the recall miss list is a recall failure, a hard positive merged into the malicious incident is a grouping-precision failure, and a collapse ratio below the bar is a grouping failure.
rules.name: AI SOC Volume Triage Discrimination Terminal Stitch
